fields.description: V3-73 kill switch for routing POS Invoice stock authority through the new fulfilment services (V3-71/V3-72) instead of ERPNext's native update_stock=1 posting. MUST stay unchecked (0/False) in every real deployment until the evidence bar in V3-70-fulfilment-accounting-transition-checklist.md Section 6 is met and a human has explicitly signed off per Section 7. Toggling this on is a deliberate, out-of-band admin action only — it is never set by any code path in this app.
fields.label: POS Stock Authority V2 Enabled
Warning
fields.options: This flag routes real POS invoices away from ERPNext's native stock posting into the new (not yet fully integration-tested) fulfilment services. Leave OFF unless you have explicitly been told to enable it as part of a signed-off rollout. See V3-70-fulfilment-accounting-transition-checklist.md.

fields.description: Gate 2 of 3 (ARCHITECTURE_POS_STOCK_AUTHORITY.md 3.4): when on, order-time capacity is expected to be backed by real URY Stock Reservation rows (see ury_kot_reservation_bridge.py) for this deployment's branches. Reservation creation/release itself always runs regardless of this flag (it never touches Bin/GL); this flag is read by ury_stock_policy.get_branch_stock_policy for callers that need to know whether reservation coverage is considered authoritative yet. Defaults off; same human-sign-off expectation as pos_stock_authority_v2.
fields.label: POS Reservation Enforcement Enabled

fields.description: Gate 3 of 3 (ARCHITECTURE_POS_STOCK_AUTHORITY.md 3.4): turns on ury_pos_closing_reconciliation.validate_closing_reconciliation for a branch -- blocking POS Closing Entry submission until every produced MADE_TO_ORDER line has a POSTED fulfilment posting intent and every reservation group is in a settleable state. MUST stay off until pos_stock_authority_v2's evidence bar is met AND ury_feature_flags._verify_fulfilment_posted_for_invoice (the G-07 posting-verification function this check calls) exists and is itself signed off -- that function is not yet implemented in this codebase. Turning this on before then will make every closing entry fail with an ImportError, not a real reconciliation result.
fields.label: POS Closing Reconciliation Enabled
Warning
fields.options: These two flags are read via ury.ury.api.ury_stock_policy.get_branch_stock_policy. Both default OFF (Tier 1). Do not enable pos_closing_reconciliation_enabled until pos_stock_authority_v2's rollout is signed off and the G-07 posting-verification function it depends on has been implemented -- see ury_pos_closing_reconciliation.py's module docstring.
